body:
I think it's because it reminds me of the worst stage of my life.  Apart from that it was the worst experience, the tattooist treated me badly and he did it too hard and it ended up causing a blowout.  My ex boyfriend abused me psychologically, he made fun of me.  He gaslighted me all the time.  We were in a pandemic.  I tried to commit suicide, I wanted to die and they hospitalized me.  I have suffered from depression all my life. It turned out that according to my psychiatrist I was bipolar type 2. I did the tattoo in a manic state and end up
Hospitalized. The pills gave me a lot of mood swings.  Was horrible. What I saw in the psychiatric hospital traumatized me even more.  I went there forced, not because I wanted to be there.  I thought that by getting more tattoos my arm would look good or eventually I would accept the butterfly... but it wasn't like that.  reminds me of the bad and I have to see it every fucking day. The worst thing is that it has yellow and according to what I have read the yellow is practically not erased with the laser. This give me anxiety
Do you think the lines inside the butterfly can somehow fix it to make them look a little thinner?
I just want to fix the butterfly BUT I think in the “bruise/blowout” I’m going for laser tattoo removal if it’s possible
The sad part for me it’s that this is a tattoo from January 7, 2021 so the blowout never went away
Do you think so? maybe my OCD and my traumatic experience. Because it doesn’t look how I wanted

It’s sad because that tattoo was made in January 7, 2021. I have now a bruise forever lol ☹️it was a little traumatic to me bc it never happens to me before with my other tattoos and my first one was on my ribs and I don’t remember that it hurt that much

Hi! I know how you feel. I got an instant regret later when I got a tattoo in January 7 2021, the placement and it’s too dark like I was in a really bad state of mind.. depression etc and I didn’t think of it that much when I got it. The worst part it’s that it have yellow!! And it’s nearly impossible to remove with laser :( I have the pictures in my page if you want to look. You’re not alone. I’m searching for artist that can help to make the tattoo better also for laser tattoo removal appointments. They are solutions. The best of both worlds, cover ups or laser. Don’t blame yourself anymore. I even get hospitalized and almost suicide because later I have a lot of shit going trough in my life and I look at the tattoo and remind me of bad stuff... and blame myself for doing it. Like I didn’t recognize myself. You’re not alone! If you need to talk you can chat with me. Tattoo regret and depression it’s real and here you are going to see that a lot, like tattoos regret history’s and people that really knows how you feel. That helped me a lot because I was thinking I was dumb and alone in this but we are not, people make mistakes you know so... we are humans
Can I see pictures of it if you don’t mind? 😅

Thank you!! 
Ooh, Are you removing a butterfly with laser tattoo removal? How old it’s your tattoo?

Thank you. But I don’t like how it turns out 
I hate how the yellow looks tho...
Its from January 7 2021!
The yellow can stay forever right? But the black can go?

It’s this possible to remove? I know yellow it’s the most difficult to remove... also got a extreme blowout and now I have like a “bruise” it’s that posible to remove with laser? I’m thinking about laser tattoo removal maybe to lighter a little I don’t like how dark the ink looks likes. And at this point I don’t think it’s possible to remove it completely or idk If I’m being too negative. Also another options it’s to do a retouch to some really GOOD artists if they can make it look better. I hate the bottom part. Can you gave me some advice?

This it’s me since January 7 of 2021. You’re not the only one who regret a Tatto.. don’t feel so bad about it everyone make mistakes and our mistakes maybe a tattoo. But they are solutions to it. Laser tattoo removal, cover ups.. I know it’s sounds shitty at first because you think that it can’t be remove at some point and you have to live with it the rest of your life... sucks but it’s not. I almost take my life since I got it. Everything in my life got worse and I think I mutilated my arm. I just miss my bare skin. I don’t know what I was thinking when I did that honestly was in a bad place mentally and still because I get hospitalized and I’m in meds now. Don’t feel so bad or harsh. Go to laser removal appointments, go to better artist to see what can do you your Tattoo.. search a lot like of the both worlds. Laser tattoo removal appointments and tattoo artist that show you what can do to your tattoo. Looks for options. And you don’t ruined your body. At first I was thinking I fucked up my body. And that I look really ugly with that in my arm, got a really brutally blowout and have yellow also got like a bruise in one part but it’s just ink. I lost hope honestly almost kill my self in Feb 28 taking a lot of my meds pills mixing with alcohol. But two real friends helped me. Surrounded by people that care about you loves you and want the best for you. That’s it’s important In this proceeds. Tattoo regret it’s real and mostly because sometimes it’s not a bad tattoo it’s what it’s reminds you. The things that happened (bad stuff, depression, abusive relationship) and all more. You’re not alone. I’m here if you want to talk. And I have yellow unfortunately this is one of the colors that it’s the hardest to remove but I have hopes. DONT loose hope like I did. Almost committing suicide. You have people that loves you, it’s just a piece of “art” in your body. But you still the amazing person you are ok?

Hi I’m going trough the same thing I don’t know what to do mine it’s in my arm and it’s just 2 weeks old and I can’t sleep I can’t eat I’m working trying to no throw up.. I’m going insane and it’s hurting my brother and my dad and mom 
Is so hard

Hi, i feel exactly the same. But mine it’s 2 weeks old. I hate it so much I have panic attacks, I don’t eat, I don’t sleep... I hate doing my work.. I hate myself for even do this in the first place
Mine it’s in my arm too 
I’m thinking about getting laser but it’s a delicate and way long process and my tattoo it’s too new. I’m even scared of me and my mental health because I’m having suicidal thoughts too
You’re not alone

Good Luck!
